title: Support Partial Tool Results / AsyncGenerator for Tool Calls in streamText

linked_prs.title: feat(ai): preliminary tool results
linked_prs.body:
## Background

Tools often need to send preliminary results, e.g. status information. We currently recommend using data parts for such use cases, but that requires creating a writer and related boilerplate code.

In AI SDK 5, we have a `toModelOutput` method, so tool outputs and what is being sent to LLMs can be easily decoupled. This opens the path for adding status information and more to tool results, and thus preliminary tool outputs with the same shape as the final output are possible without sending irrelevant information to the LLM.

## Summary

* Add support for `AsyncIterable` outputs to tool execute functions
* Add `preliminary` flag to streamed tool results
* Add `preliminary` flag to ui message tool results

## Example

```ts
tool({
  description: "Get the current weather.",
  inputSchema: z.object({ location: z.string() }),
  async *execute({ location }) {
    yield {
      status: "loading" as const,
      text: `Getting weather for ${location}`,
      weather: undefined,
    };

    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 3000));
    const temperature = 72 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 21) - 10;

    yield {
      status: "success" as const,
      text: `The weather in ${location} is ${temperature}°F`,
      weather: { temperature },
    };
  },
});
```
